items.title: Harold Mabern interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, March 31, 2010
items.q: the phone rang and it was Lee Morgan, he said, “Hey man I’ve got this gig”... So then I got the job with Lee

ctx.x: Oh well I can tell you precisely. I think, let me see now, it could have been around maybe close to ’68, ’67, ’68. Things were getting a little tight so I would always say well it’s no point in me waiting for the phone to ring so. So I said let me see what I can find. Now mind you playing music all my life I had no expertise in anything. I didn’t have any college degree, I didn’t know anything, auto mechanics, woodwork, no other skills. So I went to Alexander’s Department Store and got the job. And I had my shirt…
